newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs drop, technical problems minimize trade.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs drop, technical problems minimize trade.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed down Thursday in especially low volume as persistent technical problems made trading difficult for most of the session, brokers said.
They added the market would probably rise gently Friday.
Thursday, the General Index fell 0.48 percent to 1,555.27 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index dropped 0.21 percent to 2,102.14 points, according to preliminary stock figures.
In a total 1,364 trades, 16 stocks rose, 26 fell and 40 were stable in low volume of 12.9 million ($5.0 million).
"We were expecting a mixed session, but the constant problems had a negative effect on investors," said Manuel Bustamente of local brokerage Investa.
Benchmark Telefnica del Per accounted for 29 percent of the insignificant volume as it dipped 0.86 percent to 5.78 soles.

Among other leaders, Backus y Johnston, the country's largest brewery, fell 3.61 percent to 2.67 soles on 184,000 shares, while its sister company Compaa Nacional de Cerveza (CNC) remained stable at 1.39 soles on 136,000 shares.
